segments.source: A coalition is winning if the sum of its members’ seats reaches the threshold. Minimal winning means it is winning but removing any member makes it lose.
Which coalitions are minimal winning coalitions?
1. Majority threshold=6. 2. Add seats for each possible coalition. 3. Minimal winning coalitions: [('A', 6)].
A coalition can be winning without being minimal; removing redundant members tests how necessary each partner is.
Weighted coalition game; enumerate subsets, test threshold and minimality.
In representative bodies, groups may need to cooperate to reach a decision threshold.
Three groups have seats A=6, B=4, C=2. A governing coalition needs at least 7 seats. Any two groups may cooperate.
A coalition is winning if the sum of its members’ seats reaches the threshold. Minimal winning means it is winning but removing any member makes it lose.
Which coalitions are minimal winning coalitions?
1. Majority threshold=7. 2. Add seats for each possible coalition. 3. Minimal winning coalitions: [('AB', 10), ('AC', 8)].
AB with 10 seats; AC with 8 seats.
A coalition can be winning without being minimal; removing redundant members tests how necessary each partner is.
